app.title: Reach Fit
app.tagline: A seated light puzzle that fits your reach
page.openInHeadset: Open this page in your headset browser to play.
reach.title: Set your reach
reach.sweep: Sweep one hand across the table, as far as feels easy.
reach.gazeFallback: No hand in view? Look at the left edge, then the right edge.
reach.gazeLeft: Look at the left edge and hold
reach.gazeRight: Look at the right edge and hold
reach.done: The board now follows your reach.
reach.retry: That sweep was hard to read. Sweep once more in one smooth arc.
table.virtual: No table found. Using a virtual table.
input.pinch: Pinch a tile to turn it.
input.gaze: Or look at a tile and hold for {seconds} s.
input.controller: Or point and press the trigger.
level.label: Level {n}
level.tutorial: Turn one tile to send the light to the goal.
daily.title: Today's board
daily.done: Done for today. A new board comes tomorrow.
finish.title: All {total} levels done
save.unavailable: Progress cannot be saved in this browser.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Restart the level.
table.hand: No table found. The board sits where your hand swept.
voice.noMic: No microphone. Looking still works, and Look time sets how long to hold.
page.flatPlay: No headset? Play here: click a tile, or use the arrow keys and Enter.
